text: {"lessons":["I will avoid selling winners automatically just to secure gains; I should weigh their outlook and role in the portfolio before trimming.","I will set clear, forward-looking criteria for holding or selling losing positions instead of letting the pain of realizing a loss delay reassessment.","I will trade less reactively by focusing on long-term fundamentals, diversification and portfolio risk rather than frequent account checks or short-term price swings."]}
